viewport.base: existing engine approved landscape viewport; do not change project resolution
viewport.pixel_policy: nearest-neighbor; 2px source-snapped translation; fixed scale during shot, no continuous zoom; validate existing asset grid separately
viewport.evidence: 800x640 common canvases; never independently enlarge fragment and knife; preserve transparent origin
viewport.mobile: fit whole evidence incl fracture inside safe viewing area, no stretch. If fit loses readability use two equal-scale panels and tap-to-open, not tiny hidden hotspots.

runtime_contract.state_owner: original story executor only; these events do not independently grant evidence or mutate story
runtime_contract.completion: pure visual can finish/skip immediately; mandatory choice/evidence gate remains. Story effects remain attached to original record and commit once by original scene/record/effect key in existing save transaction
runtime_contract.save_load: persist existing source record cursor, selected callback, input pending state, existing effect execution ledger plus presentation cursor if supported. On resume restore static endframe rather than replay sound/awards
runtime_contract.replay: gallery/reference replay read-only; no story awards, time costs or conditions changed
runtime_contract.skip: skip visual tween/silence but stop at unread required input; never synthesize correct evidence, letter-close, return-stone or custody choices
runtime_contract.failed_asset_or_sound: stop dependent visual; use same-source text+existing BG; no fabricate crime reconstruction; image hold remains visible to developer
runtime_contract.idempotency: source effects must not run again on loading after a committed effect. No new named story flags invented in this document.
runtime_contract.click_semantics: While text types: first click reveals current whole line only, second independent click advances. Do not carry same pointer-up into choice/evidence underneath. Repeated rapid click cannot invoke multiple callbacks or skip mandatory input. Existing skip/read preferences preserved.

opening_to_gate_bridge.source_contract_verbatim: 진입: 초소 안, 아빠·다람·돌목, E02. 클릭 ‘신청 원본’→E03, ‘겨울 방문 규정’→E04, ‘처리표’→E02 재열람. 연결 ‘가족 방문↔신규 일꾼’→purpose_difference_known=true. 제시 ‘가족 방문·2인 숙소 확인+가족 등록 규정’→E02·E03·E04 보유 시 purpose_difference_known=true, gate_basis_proven=true, D01S04. 연결을 먼저 하지 않았어도 즉시 성공. ‘신청 2명만 제시’·‘까로의 승객 확인만 제시’·‘다른 신청서 제시’→대본의 불충분 응답, 이 장면 유지. ‘힌트를 부탁한다’→힌트 발화, 상태 그대로. 선택 질문 ‘왜 일꾼으로 바뀌었습니까?’는 purpose_difference_known=true일 때만 노출, reason_heard=true, 조사로 복귀. 이유를 듣지 않아도 성공.

아래에 있네. 다람. 둘이 온다고 제대로 썼어.

자료를 살펴보고 함께 들어갈 이유를 제시한다.
가족 방문이라고 썼잖습니까. 왜 여기엔 일꾼입니까?
……그렇군.
그럼 나도 들어가?
둘이 잘 곳까지 확인해야 하오.
13호실, 가족 두 명. 여관 확인도 여기 있습니다.

anchors.text: 너울이 보내 온 표인데…….
anchors.block_when: input=submit AND E02,E03,E04 acquired AND selected=family_visit+two_person_lodging+family_registration_rule AND purpose_difference_known=true

anchors.text: 여기서 고칠 수 있다고도 써 있네요. 다른 데로 또 가라는 말은 하지 마세요. 애 손이 얼었습니다.
anchors.block_when: input=submit AND E02,E03,E04 acquired AND selected=family_visit+two_person_lodging+family_registration_rule AND purpose_difference_known=true

anchors.text: 안 고친다는 말 아니오. 종이에서 손 좀 떼시오. 써야 하니.
anchors.block_when: input=submit AND E02,E03,E04 acquired AND selected=family_visit+two_person_lodging+family_registration_rule AND purpose_difference_known=true

anchors.text: 가족 방문이고 둘이 잘 방도 확인됐습니다. 저 규칙대로 딸도 들여보내 주세요.
anchors.block_when: input=submit AND E02,E03,E04 acquired AND selected=family_visit+two_person_lodging+family_registration_rule AND purpose_difference_known=false

anchors.text: 가족 방문을 일꾼으로 옮겨 놨군.
anchors.block_when: input=submit AND E02,E03,E04 acquired AND selected=family_visit+two_person_lodging+family_registration_rule AND purpose_difference_known=false

anchors.text: 네. 그래서 아이가 빠졌습니다.
anchors.block_when: input=submit AND E02,E03,E04 acquired AND selected=family_visit+two_person_lodging+family_registration_rule AND purpose_difference_known=false

anchors.text: 여기서 고치겠소.
anchors.block_when: input=submit AND E02,E03,E04 acquired AND selected=family_visit+two_person_lodging+family_registration_rule AND purpose_difference_known=false

anchors.text: 둘인 건 봤소. 가족을 만나러 왔는지, 둘이 잘 방은 있는지도 확인해야 하오.
같이 온 건 알겠소. 둘이 묵을 방은 확인됐소?
다른 집 종이오. 날짜와 이름부터 보시오.
가족을 만나러 온다는 신청, 둘이 잘 방. 벽에 쓰인 조건과 맞춰 보자.
그런데 왜 저를 일꾼으로 적은 겁니까?
너울이 새로 오는 어른은 가족 방문이어도 먼저 작업 명단에 넣으라더군. 장작 나를 사람이 모자라오.
전 하겠다고 한 적 없습니다.
그건 너울에게 말하시오. 잘못 적힌 걸 고칠 때 기록은 남기겠소.

Do not flatten B001 to auto grant both on entry. Engine adapter must bind those record executions to existing inspection interaction per author contract; mark mapping for review and test before calling playable. Source JSON unchanged.
opening_to_gate_bridge.correct: B004 if difference already observed, B005 direct correct if not; do not force optional reason question or replay slower route
opening_to_gate_bridge.wrong: B006 application count only, B007 passenger confirmation only, B008 other-house paper; same investigation, no evidence deletion or time penalty
opening_to_gate_bridge.optional: B010 worker reason only purpose_difference_known=true and reason_heard=false; never gate success on it
opening_to_gate_bridge.assets_hold: Owner rejected visit form art. Keep prior art available and review before replacing. Current filenames are binding candidates, not approval.
